install.title: Install El Play
install.why: Open it from your home screen like any app: full screen, no link to find, and alerts for your games.
install.bannerTitle: Get El Play on your phone
install.bannerBody: Free, no app store, in seconds
install.iosMore: Tap the three-dot button next to the address (bottom right)
install.iosMoreTop: Tap the three-dot button next to the address
install.iosShareBottom: Tap Share in the bottom bar
install.iosShareTop: Tap Share at the top right
install.iosAdd: Scroll down and tap “Add to Home Screen”
install.iosWebApp: Leave “Open as Web App” on and tap “Add”
install.browserShare: Tap Share in the address bar
install.inAppBody: You're viewing El Play inside another app (Instagram, Facebook…). It can't be installed from here: open it in your browser and follow the steps.
install.inAppFallback: Didn't open? Tap the three-dot menu at the top and choose “Open in browser”.
install.androidMenu: Tap the three-dot menu at the top right
install.androidInstall: Tap “Install app” or “Add to Home screen”
install.doneBody: El Play is on your home screen. Open it from there.
install.installedBody: You're using it from your home screen.

tutorial.detectedInApp: You're inside another app: open it in your browser first, then follow the steps.
tutorial.detectedDesktop: You're on a computer: open elplay.grullonb.com/instalar on your phone and follow the steps.

tutorial.phoneTip: Want it on your phone? Open elplay.grullonb.com/instalar on your phone.

androidMenuBy.chrome: Tap the three-dot menu at the top right
androidMenuBy.samsung: Tap the ≡ menu at the bottom right
androidMenuBy.firefox: Tap the ⋮ menu (top or bottom right)

androidInstallBy.chrome: Tap “Install app” or “Add to Home screen”
androidInstallBy.samsung: Tap “Add page to” and then “Home screen”

steps.iosChrome1: Tap Share, to the right of the address bar
steps.iosFirefox1: Tap Share in the address bar
steps.iosOther1: Tap Share (the square with an up arrow). Some browsers keep it inside the «…» menu
steps.iosOtherNote: No «Add to Home Screen»? Open El Play in Safari and follow the Safari steps.
steps.inappIos1: Tap the three dots «•••» at the top right
steps.inappNote: You can't install from inside Instagram, Facebook or TikTok: open El Play in the browser first.
steps.androidChrome2: Tap «Add to home screen» (it may say «Install app»)
steps.samsungNote: If you see the install icon in the address bar, you can tap it directly.
steps.firefox1: Tap ⋮ (top or bottom right, depending on where your toolbar is)
steps.edge1: Tap «…» in the middle of the bottom bar
steps.androidOther2: Look for «Install app» or «Add to home screen» and tap it
steps.androidOtherNote: Brave, Xiaomi, Huawei and others have it in the menu under one of those names. Can't find it? Open El Play in Chrome.
steps.desktopChrome1: Click the install icon at the right of the address bar
steps.desktopChrome2: Don't see it? Menu ⋮ → «Cast, save, and share» → «Install page as app…»
steps.desktopDone: Done! El Play opens in its own window, like any program on your computer.
steps.desktopEdge1: Click the «App available» icon in the address bar
steps.desktopEdge2: Don't see it? Menu «…» → «Apps» → «Install this site as an app»
steps.desktopSafari1: In the menu bar, click «File» → «Add to Dock»
steps.desktopSafariDone: Done! El Play stays in the Dock and opens in its own window.
steps.desktopSafariNote: Needs macOS Sonoma (14) or later. It is also under Share → «Add to Dock».
steps.desktopFirefox1: Firefox on computers doesn't install web apps yet: bookmark El Play (Ctrl+D or ⌘+D)
steps.desktopFirefoxNote: To have it as an app, open it in Chrome, Edge or Safari (Mac). On Windows, Firefox only has it as an experiment.
steps.desktopOther1: In Opera or Brave, click the install icon in the address bar (or look for «Install El Play» in the menu)
steps.desktopOtherNote: Can't find it? Open it in Chrome or Edge.

credits.label: Credits
credits.over: You're {{over}} credits over: drop or swap someone before their game starts. Otherwise the last player you added won't count.
credits.rule: You get {{budget}} credits per day. Each player costs {{min}} to {{max}} based on what he has scored this season through yesterday.
credits.short_one: {{left}} credits left and {{count}} player still to pick (the cheapest costs {{min}}): swap a pricey player for a cheaper one.
credits.short_other: {{left}} credits left and {{count}} players still to pick (the cheapest costs {{min}}): swap a pricey player for a cheaper one.

fantasy.rulesShortCredits: Pick {{batters}} hitters and 1 pitcher from the day's games (max {{perTeam}} per team) without going over your credits. Tap the crown for your captain. Each player locks when his game starts.

smart.suggestHint: The best team by projection, within your credits and the rules of the day. Players already locked stay.
smart.none: With what's still open, a full team doesn't fit your credits.
smart.idealHint: The most you could score today within the credits and the rules.
smart.idealLive: The most so far: it keeps changing while games are on.
smart.howProj: Projection: the points expected from each player today, from this season and the 3 previous LIDOM seasons (older ones count less). If he wasn't in his team's last lineup he's expected to score less. For a pitcher it depends on his outings in the last 10 days: if he started 5 or 6 days ago he's usually due to start today; if he started more recently, almost nothing (he needs rest); a reliever pitches in about 3 of every 10 games. LIDOM doesn't announce lineups or starters, so it's an estimate.
smart.howValue: Value: projected points per credit. It helps you find cheap players who deliver.
smart.howOwned: % picked: how many fans put him on their team (and how many picked each team in the predictions). It shows once his game starts, so nobody copies.
smart.howBest: Suggested and ideal team: the best possible team with 5 hitters and 1 pitcher, the per-team limit and the credits; the suggested one by projection and the ideal one by the points actually scored.
